author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!

author: Simon Mackenzie
title: WE’RE HIRING | MirrorShade Studios – Character & Creature Concept Artist
content:
WE’RE HIRING | MirrorShade Studios – Bangkok, Thailand
We’re looking for a talented Character & Creature Concept Artist to join our growing team and help bring our debut title to life.
We're seeking an artist with strong visual storytelling skills, a distinctive creative voice, and a passion for creating memorable characters and creatures.
Good working English is important.
Other positions still open:
* 3D Character Animator
* 3D Character Artist
* Game Designer
Bangkok, Thailand
Send your CV and portfolio to jobs@mirrorshadestudios.com
www.mirrorshadestudios.com
